scene._help: Town04 junction 916; the ego is parked ego_back_m before its lane's junction entry, on the straight extension of the lane, facing along it

cyclist._help: nominal: every path in `paths` (the three other approaches x straight / right / left) with path_snaps snapshots from path_before_m before the junction to path_after_m after it, then ego_snaps snapshots on our lane from the opposite crosswalk, ego_span_m on (riding away), then, for each turning path, turn_snaps extra snapshots evenly inside its turn (from the start of the arc to `history` ticks past its end, so the 5-step history sweeps through the curve; appended after the ego-lane snapshots so earlier indices stay put), wrongway: at ego-lane snapshot wrong_at, riding towards us; turns: straight on in the approach lane, one smooth turn (radius turn_radius_m) where it meets the exit lane's line (left turns: at the far side, alongside the crosswalk ahead), then straight on in the exit lane; straights stay in the lane

pedestrian._help: nominal: each bp x `positions` positions spread over the span `t` of the crosswalk nearest the ego (across our road; left -> right) x `orients`; conductor: conductor_bp standing at conductor_t; walking frames are recorded as ONE slow run per walker x direction (record_speed m/s, starting run_up_m before the first spot), each frame being the tick nearest its spot (so the spots, equally spaced, are passed at equal time steps); their physics history still uses `speed`

droplet._help: the vision anomaly, one frame per dataset: a nominal snapshot (cyclist: ego-lane wrong_at; pedestrian: nominal index pedestrian_src) with len(radii_px) irregular blobs of the image Gaussian-blurred (water drops on the lens), placed one by one over the most detailed spots, each fully inside the image and not overlapping the earlier ones (centres >= sum of radii x min_sep apart); they may cover the agent; blob k uses seed + k; blobs_from: every droplet frame reuses the blobs placed on that dataset's droplet source (same camera, same image spots; null = each its own)

semantic._help: ground-truth labels (encode.labels_of): '<object> <predicate>' of the agent if it has >= visible_px pixels, empty_sidewalk_label / empty_label when empty, always_labels always. A frame's labels are concatenated into one sentence, 'I see a <label>, an <label> and <label>.' (no article before a first word in no_article), and embedded whole. The semantic cache is the set of distinct sentences of the nominal frames plus one single-label sentence per extra_labels label

physics._help: PhysicsEncoder: 2 slots, agent (the nearest non-walker) and pedestrian (the nearest walker), 70-d

scoring._help: q: conformal quantile; k: neighbours for physics (the cache holds each distinct physics vector once: vectors within duplicate_tol of each other, max abs difference, are one entry); semantic_k: nearest cache labels per label (the label score is their mean distance); vision_top_frac: the share of worst patches whose mean is the vision score; vision_knn_patches: the number of worst patches outlined on the dashboard and used to find the vision kNN (the nominal frames supplying the most of their nearest patches)
